name: Evelyn Rojas
psychographics: Frugal to a fault; believes everything has a 'life cycle' and nothing should be wasted, not even time spent arguing with a machine.
current_solutions: Uses a landline telephone exclusively; pays her Telmex bill in person at a farmacia every two months; buys medication at the local farmacia using a handwritten receipt.
frustration: Attempted to renew her vehicle registration on the government portal at 11:30 AM; the page timed out after she entered her RFC tax ID, and the 'CAPTCHA' image was blurry, forcing her to take the whole morning off to visit the módulo de atención ciudadana in person.
decision_style: Compares prices by writing them down on a notepad; will drive across three different neighborhoods to save 50 pesos on a bag of rice.
voice: Formal and clipped; uses the formal 'usted' verb form; speaks slowly and enunciates every word, reflecting a lifelong habit of correctness.
